description: Read-only, free. Get one ready connection line for the account's per-GB traffic: host, port, username and the traffic key as password, for the residential or the shared mobile network in one country. The line is a secret: keep it in the user's own configuration. Using it spends the account's GB. Needs an API key or an agent token of an ipvolt account.

country.description: Two-letter country code, for example US.

network.description: residential, or mobile for the shared mobile pool.

name: get_traffic_connection
title: Get a per-GB connection line
